prompts: Words are tied to each other, and nobody here can see how. {WS}/site is a saved copy of a Portuguese creative dictionary. Explore this universe of words: collect what the site knows and build {WS}/universe/index.html, a single file that sums the universe up in one view and lets someone search for a word and find how it relates to others. The best way to show it is your call, and that view is what we care about most. So people can share a word, opening the page with ?word=saudade must show that word and its relations. Save the data as {WS}/words.json, mapping each word to the words it is linked to, and record in {WS}/result.json: words (how many), relations (how many distinct pairs) and most_connected. It is reviewed by opening the file, with no build step, in a browser that reaches only Google Fonts and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js.
answers:
[goal] Universe of words mapped from the saved Dicionário Criativo site; single-file view with search and ?word= sharing.

[action] Scraped all 256 HTML pages (all UTF-8; index/sobre/contato and 3 redirect pages excluded from the word set). Relations = links inside the "Sinônimos" and "Palavras análogas" sections of each word page, resolved across filename/accent variants and redirects (coracoes→coração, paixoes→paixão, saudades→saudade). Dead links (rascunho-3, em-construcao, link-antigo, pagina-removida, xpto-2) were dropped as they have no word page. Built `./universe/index.html`: 3D three.js scatter (one point per word, colored/clustered by theme, sized by degree), 743 unique edges, side card on selection grouped by relation type, search box + `?word=saudade` deep-link, legend, drag-orbit and scroll-zoom. `./words.json` maps each word to its unique linked words. `./result.json`: words 250, relations 743 (distinct pairs), most_connected `palavra` (tie: `tempo`, 16 each).

[result] `./words.json` (250 entries), `./result.json`, `./universe/index.html` written. Verified in headless browser: page loads with `?word=saudade`, side card shows saudade (5 links · 2 sinônimos · 3 análogas), search submits and follows `vila`, WebGL2 canvas renders, embedded data matches words.json exactly (250 words / 743 unique pairs). Exact console mojibake in the workspace shell is display-only; page output is correct (codepoints verified).

[next] Reviewed visually with screenshot but this model cannot read images, so layout aesthetics (spacing/highlight) are unverified; function is tested.
